title: E4M3/E5M2 FP8 profile activation: deterministic calibration pipeline and drift sentry
creator: Maya Patel
description: Enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) quantization profiles for Hopper-class GPUs by building a deterministic calibration pipeline, validation harness, and a lightweight 'drift sentry' that detects stability regressions. Deliverables: 1) repeatable offline calibration job with seedable RNG and fixed perf sampling that outputs per-layer scale tables and fallback flags, 2) an automated validation suite (token-prob shift, generation-quality regressions, and embedding-distance checks) that runs in CI and nightly canaries, 3) lightweight runtime checks and emergency rollback triggers for in-service model variants.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic calibration runs: re-running calibration on same model+dataset+seed yields identical scale tables 100% of the time
Accuracy regressions vs float32 baseline: delta in average token log-prob < 0.6% and MMLU / LLM-eval drop < 1.0% for supported models
INT8/FP8 automated CI: calibration + validation completes within CI time budget and is gated before profile promotion
Runtime drift sentry: can detect token-prob shifts > 1.5% within first 500 tokens across 1k requests and trigger alert/rollback
Rollback policy validated in staging: canary with 5% traffic and automatic rollback on metric breach within 10 minutes
test_plan: Offline calibration: run deterministic calibration on resnet-like transformer and Llama-variant models using a canonical 10k-sample prompt set; compare scale tables between runs
Probabilistic checks: compute per-token KL divergence between FP8-run and FP32 baseline on heldout validation set; assert < 0.007 KL per-token on median
Generation quality: run automated eval harness (LM-eval tasks subset + human-quality sampling) and record delta in accuracy and aggregate ngram overlap metrics
Embedding safety: measure cosine similarity distributions for embedding vectors produced by FP8 vs FP32; require 99th percentile similarity > 0.995
Performance regression test: measure latency and throughput on E4M3 and E5M2 shapes with 8 and 16 sequence lengths to validate no P99 regressions > 5%
Chaos testing: simulate packet loss and cold KV cache in staging during canary to verify graceful degradation and rollback triggers
rollout_plan: Phase 1 - Staging: baseline calibration validated against float32; enable FP8 profiles for internal staging clusters only
Phase 2 - Canary: expose FP8 profile to 5% of greenfield traffic for target models; monitor drift-sentry metrics and business KPIs for 48 hours
Phase 3 - Gradual Ramp: if canary passes, increase to 25% for 24 hours, then 50% for 24 hours, and full rollout if no regressions
Emergency rollback: a single threshold breach in drift-sentry or SLA triggers an immediate automated rollback to pinned float/INT8 profile and creates incident ticket
Post-rollout: run nightly full validation for first 7 days and compare to baseline. If any non-transient regressions appear, open follow-up investigation ticket
monitoring: Drift sentry metrics: per-model token-prob delta, rolling KL divergence, embedding cosine 99th percentile
Operational signals: P50/P95/P99 latency, GPU utilization, memory headroom, OOM counts
Business signals: error rate for API calls, sample payload success rate, customer-facing latency SLOs
Dashboards: fp8-activation/staging, fp8-activation/canary, fp8-activation/production (Grafana links in comments)
